nom: Beauty of Joseon Red Bean Pore Refreshing Mask Mud Cream Hydrating Wash Off Pack

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report the mask reduces oil and shine and helps minimize pores without leaving skin over-dried, including one who used it as her main oil-control routine for years.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the mask leaves their skin soft and refreshed without the tightness or dryness some other masks cause, though one hasn't yet seen a reduction in pore size after a few uses; a separate very-oily-skin reviewer specifically warns dry skin against using it, expecting it to over-dry and trigger breakouts.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin calls it the first exfoliating mask that didn't dry or peel her skin, while another reviewer, who has very oily skin, says combination skin doesn't respond as well to it.
segments.sensitive: Self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including one whose skin normally turns red and splotchy from clay or exfoliating masks, report no burning, stinging, or irritation with this one.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who mentions older skin reports it leaves her face moisturized and rejuvenated.
segments.normal: No self-described normal-skin reviewer reports on the mask directly, but one very-oily-skin reviewer cautions that normal skin would likely be over-dried by it and end up with more breakouts.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, report the mask cleans and exfoliates without leaving skin tight or dried out; one reviewer, however, says it left her skin dry and itchy after washing it off.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers explicitly note the absence of burning, stinging, or tingling, including one whose skin normally reacts to clay and exfoliating masks; one reviewer, however, reports her skin burned during application.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with combination skin reports it removes blackheads around the nose, but a different reviewer reports the mask caused more acne to break out on her face.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report reduced shine and oiliness after use, describing it as removing excess oil and grime without stripping the skin.

aspects.libelle: Generous jar size for the price
Dries comfortably without feeling too tight
Some containers arrive used or underfilled
Small spatula applicator hard to spread

extraits.texte: I purchased this pore mask because I had seen it on TikTok which said it is great for oily skin, so I had to purchase it because I wear makeup often and I needed a product that with unclog my pores. I used this mask last night and as soon as I put it on my skin it was burning. The smell was also unpleasant, the smell of play dough. After 15 minutes of wearing it on my skin it seemed to be drying the oils on skin. After washing it off it left my skin dry and itchy and I’m pretty sure it caused more acne to come out on my face. Word of advice do not buy this product unless you want more acne!!!

extraits.titre: Gentle Feel, Awaiting Visible Results on Dry Skin
extraits.texte: I've been using the Beauty of Joseon Red Bean Pore Refreshing Mask (Mud Cream Hydrating Wash Off Pack) for about 3-4 times now. As someone with dry skin, I was looking for a mask that would be hydrating while also addressing my concerns about large pores. After washing it off, my skin does feel quite good – it's soft and refreshed, which is a definite plus. However, in terms of visible changes to my skin's overall appearance or a reduction in the size of my large pores, I haven't noticed significant results yet. Given that I've only used it a few times, I'm planning to continue using this mask for a few more months to give it a fair chance to see if there are any long-term benefits. It's a pleasant experience to use, but the jury is still out on its efficacy for my specific concerns.

I love a good mask. I love skincare. This is a great mask. It's easy to apply and rinse off and doesn't dry down and make your skin feel tight. I have dry skin and this works well for me. I love that it has exfoliant in it so when I apply it, I can rub it into my skin and exfoliate then leave it on for a while, rinse it off and my skin feels smooth and refreshed. The quantity of product in this jar is amazing. Usually you don't get much in these types of products but this one is packed full of product so it will last for a while. Overall, my experience has been great with this mask. The scent isn't strong at all and it leaves my skin looking and feeling beautiful. Dry skin approved!

I like this product a lot, I can definitely tell the difference on my face that it’s softer and exfoliates the oil and grime off my face as someone with oily skin. Though the product is wonderful and I highly recommend it, I happened to dig through more of the product and saw something white poking through, I pulled it out hoping it wasn’t something weird because it had a rubber texture, but it was just a piece of a torn glove lol, at least I assume so, it’s the only reasonable explanation .😭

So this is our extremely oily skin. This is not for combination. Skin does not work that well on it. If your skin is oily due to make up, this is not the product for you. I use this to minimize my pores.. it works, wonders it leaves my skin, soft and moisturized without the oily shine that I normally have. It lasts for an extremely long amount of time for the size of the container. I am happy with the product. I have been using their products for a while. I am 38 years old and I have always had extremely oily skin. I didn’t buy this because of TikTok. I bought this because I was looking for something that would help remove oil. So I’ve read on some of the reviews people say that it smells bad. I think it smells like bean paste. It doesn’t really have a clay texture because I also have clay masks, and I can feel the difference at the texture. For me, it does not sting my face unlike when I do my clay mask with apple cider vinegar. I can feel that one tightening my face. This one is a soothing oil remover that I sometimes forget I have on my face. I can walk around my whole house with it on and wash it off after 10 minutes sometimes I leave it on longer cause like I said I forget that it’s there. I would recommend this every single time. I have my I would never recommend this for someone who has dry skin or normal skin cause this would probably dry you out so much that it would cause you to get more acne. So I will emphasize to definitely know your skin type.

extraits.titre: Worth the hype!!! Friendly for all skin types!!
extraits.texte: One word. OBSESSED!!!!! I have combination skin, and I've never gotten an exfoliating mask that didn't make my face dry or peel my skin raw until this one! My skin feels soft and rejuvenated after using this product, and it doesn't overdo the scrubbing. It's extremely gentle and does an amazing job of getting those pesky blackheads off around the nose. Earases then almost instantly. Smell is also pleasant! Smells like bananas to me! Highly recommend!!!

So far after only one use, I really enjoy the mask. I can’t speak to its exfoliating properties because I haven’t been using it long enough, but I can speak to the immediate effects. My skin is super sensitive. If you poke my skin, it will turn red and splotchy. A lot of clay/exfoliating masks will burn as soon as it touches my skin. I read another review saying this mask made their skin burn, so I was just expecting the same to happen for me, but it didn’t! No burning or tingling at all, and the grains are very very soft and not scratchy at all. I was expecting it to be a lot like the Glow Recipe hyaluronic clay mask, which burned the crap out of my face, so much so that my eyes watered. It is nothing like that mask, and it’s very soothing if anything. The grains/granules are soft but also hard enough to get the feeling of a physical exfoliator. It also doesn’t dry down and get itchy or cracky like a typical clay mask. It also smells like bananas to me lol I love my first experience and I can’t wait to use it more often and see results from the exfoliation!
